metadata.case_name: LAI YIU FONG v. FANCY EFFORT LTD

injuries.description: fracture of distal tibia and fibula
source: X-ray of left lower leg revealed fracture of distal tibia and fibula ("the Injuries").
The plaintiff sustained lower left leg and foot injury.

manifestations.description: tenderness, swelling and bruise over the left lower leg
mild decrease in dorsiflexion, eversion and inversion
mild swelling in the lower left leg and ankle as a result of thickening of cortical bone
residual stiffness of his left leg
less endurance on prolonged, heavy manual work and prolonged squatting

source: The plaintiff was admitted to the orthopaedic ward, and was discharged on 9 September 2009.

treatments_received.treatment: long leg cast (with subsequent re-casting due to displacement)
source: After swelling of his left leg subsided, the plaintiff was given a long cast on his left leg. Unfortunately, the long leg cast was loosened at time of receiving rehabilitation, displacement of fracture was found and a new cast has to be applied.
X-ray of left lower leg revealed fracture of distal tibia and fibula ("the Injuries").

treatments_received.treatment: physiotherapy (non weight bearing exercise, magnetic field therapy, pressure therapy and exercise therapy) - 19 sessions
source: In the report by Ms Lai Pui Wan of the Physiotherapy Department of TMH dated 11 August 2010, the plaintiff was given non weight bearing exercise, magnetic field therapy, pressure therapy and exercise therapy. The plaintiff attended 19 sessions of physiotherapy treatments.
The plaintiff received 9 sessions of occupational therapy treatments in TMH.
After discharge from TMH, in a follow up treatment on 8 March 2010, his fractures were found to have healed and leg pain was lessened.

losses.description: Residual stiffness on his left ankle resulting in mild decrease in dorsiflexion, eversion and inversion and less endurance on prolonged, heavy manual work
